description: This file defines the NotificationRepository interface which extends JpaRepository and provides methods for querying Notification entities based on Event and User entities.

classes.name: NotificationRepository
classes.description: Repository interface for Notification entity, providing methods to find notifications by event and user, and to find the latest notification for a given event.

methods.name: findFirstByEventOrderByCreatedDesc
methods.description: Finds the most recently created Notification for a specific Event.

methods.name: findByEvent
methods.description: Finds all Notifications associated with a specific Event.

methods.name: findByUser
methods.description: Finds all Notifications associated with a specific User.
